Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: ‘An embodiment of white fears’: how zombies went from Haitian spiritual tradition to Hollywood monsters
item.description: Maya Annik Bedward’s fascinating new documentary goes beyond reductive imagery to place the zombie and vodou in their true historical context American film has a canon of racist disinformation that famously includes The Birth of a Nation , King Kong (1933) and Gone With the Wind . A new documentary makes a compelling argument that zombies, as presented, commodified and popularized by Hollywood, are part of the same tradition. item.title: World must reject climate culture wars or face economic ruin, says UN’s Stiell
item.description: Warning by United Nations climate chief comes as EU data shows August 2026 was joint hottest month ever Attempts to stoke a climate crisis culture war must be rejected or the world will face economic disaster, the UN’s climate chief has warned. Simon Stiell, the executive secretary of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, warned that this year’s “hot as hell” summer had killed tens of thousands of people in Europe alone and “hammered” infrastructure, businesses and economics, costing a likely €180bn (£155bn), as well as leading to forced migration around the world. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Apple's new foldable iPhone: expensive gadget or bold statement?
item.description: John Ternus, Apple's new CEO, unveiled the tech giant's latest smartphone on Wednesday. The foldable iPhone Duo will go on sale on October 23rd starting at $1,999, making it the most expensive iPhone to date. The move is a bid to comfort the US company's position at the top of the global smartphone market. Also in this edition, we head to Argentina where President Javier Milei's free market approach has led to a downturn in manufacturing. Fuente: France 24 - English.
